mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_orders ( order_id, member_id, member_membership_id, pg_provider, amount, status, idempotency_key, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{membershipId}, #{pgProvider}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT po.id, po.order_id, po.member_id, po.member_membership_id AS membership_id, po.payment_id, po.pg_provider, po.amount, po.status, po.payment_key, po.idempotency_key, po.expires_at, po.approved_at FROM payment_orders po JOIN members m ON m.id = po.member_id WHERE po.order_id = #{orderId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT po.id AS payment_order_id, po.member_id, po.member_membership_id AS membership_id, mm.status AS membership_status FROM payment_orders po JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = po.member_membership_id WHERE po.status = 'READY' AND po.expires_at < #{now} AND mm.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY po.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE

SELECT po.id AS payment_order_id, po.member_id, po.member_membership_id AS membership_id, mm.status AS membership_status FROM payment_orders po JOIN members m ON m.id = po.member_id JOIN member_memberships mm ON mm.id = po.member_membership_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND po.status = 'READY' AND po.expires_at < #{now} AND mm.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CANCELLED') ORDER BY po.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'APPROVING', payment_key = #{paymentKey}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY' AND expires_at > #{now}

UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'PAID', payment_id = #{paymentId}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, failure_code = NULL, failure_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVING'
UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVING'
UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'EXPIRED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{paymentOrderId} AND status = 'READY'

UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'COMPENSATING', compensation_idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVING'

UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'COMPENSATED', compensation_transaction_key = #{transactionKey}, compensated_at = #{compensatedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COMPENSATING'

UPDATE payment_orders SET status = 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED', failure_code = #{failureCode}, failure_message = #{failureMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'COMPENSATING'
